reproduce.readOnlySql:
WITH target AS (
  SELECT * FROM public.supplier_price_releases
  WHERE id='e9517ad0-3e11-4f52-a73f-71875a5b2d4a'::uuid
), batch_summary AS (
  SELECT count(*) AS total_batches,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.status='completed') AS completed_batches,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.status<>'completed') AS incomplete_batches,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.status IN ('queued','running','retrying') AND b.lease_expires_at>clock_timestamp()) AS active_leases,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE b.attempt>1) AS retried_batches,
    coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('batch_number',b.batch_number,'attempt',b.attempt,'status',b.status,
      'cursor_start',b.cursor_start,'cursor_end',b.cursor_end,'row_count',b.row_count,
      'completed_at',b.completed_at)) FILTER (WHERE b.attempt>1),'[]'::jsonb) AS retried_batch_details,
    min(b.cursor_start) AS first_cursor,max(b.cursor_end) AS last_cursor,
    sum(b.row_count) AS batch_rows
  FROM public.supplier_price_release_batches b JOIN target r ON r.id=b.release_id
), row_summary AS (
  SELECT count(*) AS persisted_rows,count(DISTINCT x.source_row_number) AS distinct_source_rows,
    min(x.source_row_number) AS first_source_row,max(x.source_row_number) AS last_source_row,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.row_status='accepted') AS accepted_rows,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.row_status='rejected') AS rejected_rows,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.row_status='conflict') AS conflict_rows,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.row_status='warning') AS warning_rows
  FROM public.supplier_price_release_rows x JOIN target r ON r.id=x.release_id
)
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
  'captured_at',clock_timestamp(),
  'release',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('id',r.id,'organization_id',r.organization_id,'supplier_id',r.supplier_id,
    'brand_id',r.brand_id,'status',r.status,'total_rows',r.total_rows,'processed_rows',r.processed_rows,
    'current_cursor',r.current_cursor,'accepted_rows',r.accepted_rows,'rejected_rows',r.rejected_rows,
    'warning_rows',r.warning_rows,'conflict_rows',r.conflict_rows,'error_code',r.error_code,
    'source_sha256',r.source_file_sha256,'source_verification_required',r.source_verification_required,
    'created_at',r.created_at,'uploaded_at',r.uploaded_at,'validated_at',r.validated_at,'published_at',r.published_at,
    'updated_at',r.updated_at,'brand_review_required',r.brand_identity_audit->'review_required') FROM target r),
  'upload',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('id',u.id,'status',u.status,'total_bytes',u.total_bytes,
    'uploaded_bytes',u.uploaded_bytes,'checksum_sha256',u.checksum_sha256,'completed_at',u.completed_at)
    FROM public.supplier_price_upload_sessions u JOIN target r ON r.id=u.release_id
    WHERE u.id='0481b291-ed2f-45da-a830-b92f46fb0567'::uuid),
  'handoff',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('id',h.id,'status',h.status,'workflow_id',h.workflow_id,
    'source_sha256',h.source_sha256,'source_bytes',h.source_bytes,'total_rows',h.total_rows,'enqueued_at',h.enqueued_at)
    FROM supplier_price_ingestion_internal.handoffs h JOIN target r ON r.id=h.release_id
    WHERE h.id='4537355e-d007-4298-889b-5687d066ba60'::uuid),
  'batches',(SELECT to_jsonb(b) FROM batch_summary b),
  'rows',(SELECT to_jsonb(x) FROM row_summary x),
  'current_pointer',(SELECT to_jsonb(p) FROM public.supplier_current_price_pointers p JOIN target r
    ON p.organization_id=r.organization_id AND p.supplier_id=r.supplier_id AND p.brand_id=r.brand_id),
  'release_publication_count',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.supplier_price_publications p JOIN target r ON p.release_id=r.id)
) AS evidence;
